name: example-cheap-proof-docs
goal: Provide a repeatable cheap proof plan for docs-oriented orchestration with lean worker output and low effort defaults.

sharedContext.summary: Make one bounded quickstart documentation improvement and run it through a lean reviewer so repeated live proofs stay cheap without relaxing coordinator review or docs validation.
constraints: Prefer terse worker output; empty arrays are better than padded notes.
Do not edit TODO.md, ai/state files, ai/log files, or ai/indexes.

tasks.title: Tighten quickstart README scanability
tasks.prompt: Improve the quickstart README so a developer can scan the example faster. Focus on one small orientation pass: what the example demonstrates, which endpoint to try first, and which source file to inspect next. Keep the diff short.

tasks.title: Review the quickstart README pass
tasks.prompt: Review the README change for accuracy, clarity, and whether it makes the quickstart easier to scan without overstating the implementation. Call out only concrete risks.
